title: Nonlinear Control Synchronization Method for Fractional-order Time Derivatives Chaotic Systems
summary: "Synchronization of two dynamical systems" is the term used to describe the phenomenon when two or more systems gradually change their states or behaviors to become similar or identical. This can happen in a lot of fields, such as physics, engineering, biology, and economics. Synchronization finds applications in neurology and communication systems. It is present in both man-made and organic systems.
